messages:
mira (Infra PM): Kicking off Epsilon region onramp discussion. Need procurement anchors, launch gates, and customer allocation rules. Who can own the commitment breakpoints?

sam (SRE): I can draft the runbook for phased turnup. main worry: p95 latency SLOs with shared burst.

ev an (Head Eng-Infra): @sam +1. Also want clear thresholds for when we pause new customer signups in-region.

liam (Procurement): From procurement POV we can commit to a 6-month reserved tranche. Need a table of target GPU counts by phase before I talk to vendors.

mira (Infra PM): Rough targets I pulled from product:
```
Phase A (canary): 24 GPUs reserved, 12 burst (spot)
Phase B (scale): additional 72 reserved, 48 burst
Phase C (steady): 200 reserved, 100 burst pool across zones
Launch KPI: onboarding 3 pilot customers, <1% error budget burn/week, p95 gen latency <120ms
```

jess (Sales SE): For pilots, customers want guaranteed capacity for 2-week windows and an escape to dedicated if perf drops. Need SLA language.

sam (SRE): SLA toggle is fine but ops needs pre-warmed pools. That affects cost. Suggest gating: only enable paid pilots after canary runs 72h with no >5% tail regressions.

ev an (Head Eng-Infra): Agree to 72h stability gate. Add rollback policy: if p99 latency >300ms for 10min, auto-fallback to regional fallback model.

liam (Procurement): Vendor asks: commitment breakpoints we can negotiate: 25%, 50%, 100% of planned reserved order, with 30/60/90 day lead windows. We should specify which business events trigger each tranche.

mira (Infra PM): Proposed triggers: 25% on pilot signoff, 50% when MRR from region >$X for 2 consecutive months, 100% on Enterprise contract close or Q commit vote. Thoughts?

jess (Sales SE): Make that deterministic: pilot signoff = 3 pilots live + ops green. MRR threshold needs product to confirm number => I'll sync with growth.

sam (SRE): Operational constraints: burst pool must be cross-az to handle zone failures. Also want a cooldown window for scale-down to avoid oscillation (recommend 15m).

evan (Head Eng-Infra): Cost guardrails: add a hard budget checkpoint before moving from 50%->100% commit. Finance should sign off. Also add an OKR line: reduce in-region per-token cost by 12% vs hosted baseline.

mira (Infra PM): OKR alignment noted. Drafting launch criteria doc now. Will include: capacity numbers, stability gate (72h), rollback triggers, customer allocation policy, procurement breakpoints, finance sign-off.

liam (Procurement): One more: specify acceptable GPU mix (A100 vs H100). Vendors push H100 price but lead time longer. We should define fallback sku list.

sam (SRE): Fallback plan: if H100 not available, use A100 with software quantization profile. Perf delta documented in rollout playbook.

ops-bot: scheduled: create-ticket infra/epsilon-onramp-2026 at 1759995400

mira (Infra PM): Action items: @liam prepare vendor ask sheet by EOD Thu; @sam write runbook and cooldown rules by next Tue; @jess confirm pilot acceptance criteria with customers; @evan coordinate finance checkpoint.

jess (Sales SE): noted. I'll push pilot acceptance checklist to the shared folder and ping pilot customers.

evan (Head Eng-Infra): Good. We'll lock phase A reserves once procurement has vendor term options. Keep decisions on this thread.

mira (Infra PM): Thanks — I'll post the initial gating doc in #eng-infra and tag for review. :thumbsup:
